entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is an application seeking pre-arrest bail filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.831 of 2024 of Kozhinjampara Police Station, Palakkad registered for the offences punishable under Sections 465, 468, 471 and 420 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

According to the prosecution, the 1 st and 2nd accused, along with other accused, fabricated a fake insurance certificate of 'Universal Sompo General Insurance Company' in the name of a lorry bearing registration No.TN-55-AL-7211 for the period from 03.07.2019 to 02.07.2020, and the same was submitted before the Kozhinjampara Police Station in Crime No.393/2019 and the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Palakkad, and thereby committed the offences alleged.
4. Heard Smt. Celia Santhosh, the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Smt. Sreeja V., the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. Petitioner is alleged to have enabled the owner of a vehicle to fabricate a fake insurance certificates of an insurance 2025:KER:59753 company for the purpose of claiming compensation for a motor vehicle accident pursuant to the death of three persons in the accident.

entities.text: Kozhinjampara Police Station in Crime No.393/2019
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Though the learned counsel for the petitioner vehemently contended that petitioner has no involvement in the crime and he is only an insurance agent having been roped in without any basis, since petitioner has criminal antecedents, which was investigated by the Crime Branch at Chennai, on a similar allegation, and was in custody from 30.11.2024 till 22.01.2025, I am of the view that petitioner cannot be protected with an order of pre-arrest bail.
6. The allegation of forgery of an insurance certificate is a serious offence, and the same will affect the public at large.
Having regard to the above circumstances, I am of the view that this is not a fit case to protect the petitioner with an order of pre-arrest bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed.

However, in case the petitioner surrenders before the investigating officer on 19.08.2025, he shall be subjected to custodial interrogation, and thereafter,
if arrested, be produced before the jurisdictional court and if any application for bail is filed, the court shall consider the same in accordance with law.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE jka/08.08.25.
